articles.title: Microsoft emite alerta por nuevo ataque a Windows que usa captchas falsos para infectar el equipo
articles.text:
Microsoft advirtió sobre una campaña maliciosa activa que utiliza sitios web comprometidos para engañar a los usuarios y lograr que instalen una puerta trasera capaz de otorgar acceso remoto a redes internas de organizaciones. La compañía bautizó la operación como TerminalFix, en referencia a su parecido con los ataques clásicos conocidos como ClickFix, aunque con una variante que apunta directamente a la terminal de comandos de Windows.
Cuando un usuario visita alguno de los sitios web afectados por la campaña, se le presenta una superposición que simula ser una verificación de captcha de Cloudflare. El mensaje le indica que debe completar el proceso copiando y ejecutando un comando de PowerShell, ya sea en la Terminal de Windows o directamente en PowerShell.
PUBLICIDAD
Según los investigadores de seguridad de Microsoft, Sagar Patil, Suriyaraj Natarajan y Parasharan Raghavan, esta variante se diferencia de los ataques ClickFix tradicionales, que suelen dirigir a las víctimas al cuadro de diálogo Ejecutar de Windows.
“Las campañas TerminalFix aplican la misma técnica pero dirigen a los usuarios a la Terminal de Windows o PowerShell en su lugar, lo que aumenta la probabilidad de que scripts complejos de múltiples líneas se ejecuten con éxito”, explicaron los investigadores en un análisis publicado esta semana.
PUBLICIDAD
La campaña tiene como objetivo a organizaciones de múltiples sectores y recurre a sitios web comprometidos como punto de entrada para difundir estas falsas verificaciones.
Un proceso de infección en varias etapas
El ataque, según describió Microsoft, constituye un proceso sofisticado de múltiples fases que combina la técnica de sideloading de DLL, extracción esteganográfica de cargas útiles, reconocimiento extensivo de Active Directory y un implante personalizado de túnel inverso.
PUBLICIDAD
Al ejecutar el comando malicioso, el sistema de la víctima descarga un archivo ZIP que contiene un binario legítimo, identificado como “LockScreenContentServer.exe”, junto con un archivo DLL fraudulento llamado “dui70.dll”. Esta combinación permite iniciar el ataque de sideloading, mediante el cual el binario legítimo carga la DLL maliciosa.
Esa DLL comprometida se encarga de recuperar cargas útiles adicionales ocultas dentro de imágenes en formato PNG, alojadas en dominios externos como “bestsocialmedianewspapper[.]com” u “offlineupdater[.]com”. Además, establece persistencia en el sistema a través de claves de registro y tareas programadas, para lo cual garantiza que el ataque continúe activo incluso después de reinicios del equipo.
PUBLICIDAD
Una puerta al interior de la red
El componente final de la cadena de infección es un implante personalizado en Python, identificado como “client.py”. Este programa crea una conexión cifrada mediante WebSocket hacia la infraestructura de los atacantes, específicamente hacia el dominio “gitnow[.]dev:443”, y funciona como un proxy estilo SOCKS5 que otorga acceso a la red interna de la víctima.
Con esta herramienta, los atacantes pueden conectarse a máquinas internas, examinar controladores de dominio, ejecutar comandos y mantener el acceso de forma persistente. En la práctica, el equipo comprometido se convierte en un punto de apoyo para desplazarse lateralmente dentro de la red de una organización.
PUBLICIDAD
Durante la fase de reconocimiento, el malware recopila metadatos del sistema, realiza descubrimiento de relaciones de confianza entre dominios, enumera cuentas de administrador de dominio y ejecuta búsquedas en usuarios y equipos de Active Directory. También envía pings a servidores designados para mapear la topología de la red interna.
Paralelamente, el ataque instala un bucle persistente de PowerShell que vigila un archivo de texto en busca de nuevos comandos, los ejecuta mediante la función Invoke-Expression y registra los resultados en un archivo de salida.
PUBLICIDAD
Microsoft precisó que, hasta el momento, no observó a los atacantes llevar a cabo movimientos laterales de forma efectiva, por lo que resulta difícil determinar el uso final que planean dar al acceso obtenido. No obstante, advirtió que ese tipo de acceso suele explotarse después para escalar privilegios, desactivar controles de seguridad, extraer información sensible y desplegar ransomware en toda la organización afectada.
Recomendaciones para mitigar el riesgo
Microsoft instó a las organizaciones a tratar los dispositivos afectados como posibles puntos de pivote en la red e investigar la existencia de movimientos laterales o exposición de credenciales. Entre las medidas de mitigación recomendadas se encuentran restringir la ejecución de PowerShell y del cuadro de diálogo Ejecutar para usuarios estándar mediante herramientas como AppLocker, Application Control for Windows o Directivas de Grupo.
PUBLICIDAD
La compañía también sugirió bloquear o auditar el acceso al cuadro de diálogo Ejecutar (Win+R) cuando no sea necesario, monitorear indicadores de sideloading de DLL, capacitar a los empleados para reconocer ataques del tipo ClickFix y habilitar el registro de bloques de script de PowerShell para detectar y analizar comandos ofuscados o codificados.
PUBLICIDAD
PUBLICIDAD

articles.title: Una ONG quiere mandar una misión a Alfa Centauri en 2029. Solo tardará 80.000 añitos en llegar
articles.text:
“¿Dónde está todo el mundo?” Con esa corta frase, el físico Enrico Fermi enunció en 1950 la paradoja que hoy lleva su nombre. Básicamente, se preguntaba por qué no hemos encontrado ninguna otra civilización inteligente en el Universo. ¿Acaso estamos solos? Tenemos más que explorado nuestro sistema solar, por lo que está claro que, para encontrarla, tendríamos que ir más lejos. Por eso, la organización sin ánimo de lucro Fermi Explorer Mission planea lanzar en 2029 una pequeña sonda con destino a Alfa Centauri. No sabemos si encontrarán algo en su destino y lo cierto es que nunca lo sabremos, pues el trayecto se alargaría durante 80.000 años. Sin embargo, según los responsables de la misión, eso la hace aún más atractiva.
Una pequeña nave y decenas de miles de años. Aún no se ha construido la nave ni se ha señalado qué empresas se encargarán de ello. No obstante, el presidente de la organización, Philip Johnston, dio ayer los primeros datos al respecto. Se espera que la sonda tenga una masa de entre 100 y 200 kg, con una carga útil de al menos 1 kg. La propulsión será eléctrica y para todo ello se requerirá una inversión de unos 15 millones de dólares.
La primera misión dirigida. Fermi Explorer Mission no será la primera misión que viajará más allá de los confines de nuestro sistema solar. De hecho, las sondas Voyager ya superaron esa barrera en 2012 y 2018. Sin embargo, hay una gran diferencia entre estas tres misiones, ya que actualmente las sondas Voyager vagan por el espacio interestelar, después de superar su trabajo estudiando Júpiter, Saturno, Urano y Neptuno, pero ya no tienen ningún destino marcado. La misión que se lanzará en 2029, en cambio, sí que tiene una meta concreta: alfa Centauri. Este es el sistema estelar más cercano al nuestro, a 4,4 años luz. Un buen destino al que viajar en primer lugar.
Sin tecnologías. Fermi Explorer Mission tampoco es la primera idea de misión interestelar con un destino concreto. Por ejemplo, según explican en Space, el proyecto Breakthrough Starshot se ideó con el objetivo de lanzar sondas a Proxima Centauri. Sin embargo, para ello se quería usar un sistema de propulsión por láser que aún no existe hoy en día. Idear misiones a corto plazo con tecnologías relativamente futuristas no suele salir bien. La propulsión eléctrica, en cambio, es una realidad mucho más accesible.
La paradoja de Fermi. Según la paradoja de Fermi, hay tres posibles motivos por los que aún no hemos encontrado otras civilizaciones inteligentes: o existieron pero se extinguieron, o no se dejan ver (por elección o por circunstancias) o realmente la inteligencia extraterrestre es más rara de lo que parece. Con misiones como la que plantean estos científicos, entre los que se encuentra también el ex presidente de Blue Origin Rob Meyerson, se pretende inspirar a futuras generaciones para buscar más allá de nuestro vecindario.
Quienes han lanzado la misión no verán el resultado. Tampoco lo harán sus hijos, ni los hijos de sus hijos. Ni siquiera podemos saber si dentro de 80.000 años seguirá existiendo la humanidad. Pero, tanto si existe como si no, habría una nave creada por humanos viajando por el espacio, con el fin de demostrar que existimos y no nos rendimos en la búsqueda de semejantes. En esta misión, al contrario que en otras, el objetivo no es leer los resultados, sino inspirar a otros para que den el salto.

articles.title: Dell étoffe son entrée de gamme avec un nouveau concurrent au MacBook Neo sous les 1000 €
articles.text:
Dell étoffe son entrée de gamme avec un nouveau concurrent au MacBook Neo sous les 1000 €
Le Dell 14S veut empiéter sur les plates-bandes du MacBook Neo en se positionnant comme le PC portable parfaitement destiné aux étudiants. Processeur Intel Wildcat Lake et coloris multiples sont au programme de ce laptop à moins de 1000 €.
Dire qu'il a fallu attendre une crise de composants sans précédent et la secousse MacBook Neo pour que les constructeurs informatiques se décident enfin à monter le niveau de leur offre d'entrée de gamme - par pur opportunisme, certes, mais quand même : après le Swift Air d'Acer, c'est au tour de Dell de sortir son concurrent au fameux laptop budget d'Apple. Ainsi, voilà le Dell 14S, un SKU déjà existant dans le portfolio de la gamme - tout du moins, outre-Atlantique - désormais repositionné pour attirer les étudiants.
Les détails sur ce Dell 14S version 2026 sont épars : de notre investigation en plein cœur de l'IFA à Berlin, tout juste sait-on que ce PC portable bureautique embarquera les processeurs Intel Core série 3 (du Core 3 au Core 7) de génération Wildcat Lake ; le choix de tous les laptops budget Windows 11. Sa construction tout en métal nous a paru plus solide que le châssis en plastique proposé par Acer dans le Swift Air, et le clavier nous a paru tout à fait réactif. Concession logique pour le pavé tactile qui fait l'impasse sur les retours haptiques pour une construction cliquable plus économique.
Côté connectique, le Dell 14S retrouve 2 ports USB-C 3.2 Gen 2, un port HDMI 1,4 et une sortie casque - dont l'absence sur le Dell XPS 13, pourtant aussi pensé comme un laptop à destination des étudiants, nous paraît encore plus étrange. Les 4 coloris proposés (vert, beige, rose et bleu) cherchent à attirer le regard des voisins indiscrets en amphithéâtre, tout comme le tarif d'entrée puisque l'on nous promet un positionnement sous la barre des 1000 €... Sans que l'on en sache vraiment plus. À titre de comparaison, le MacBook Neo est aujourd'hui tarifé à 799 € depuis les récentes hausses de tarifs chez Apple. Rendez-vous en hiver pour en savoir plus.

articles.title: Malicious Apache Modules Hijack Brazilian Government Site Traffic to Push Betting Pages
articles.text:
A Chinese-speaking cybercrime cluster known as Gambling Goblin has been observed installing malicious Apache modules on compromised web servers run by Brazilian government and educational institutions, and using them to divert visitors to attacker-controlled pages promoting online gambling and sports betting.
Check Point Research said it has tracked the campaign since mid-2025.
The modules reverse-proxy visitors to a set of phishing pages while the traffic still appears to originate from the legitimate domain. The site's own security headers are stripped, allowing the injected content to run freely.
Those pages pose as trusted app stores including Google Play, Microsoft Store, and Amazon, and push online gambling and sports betting behind that facade.
Check Point said the likely goal is search engine optimization (SEO) manipulation at scale, with compromised high-reputation domains, many of them Brazilian government sites, chained together to inflate search rankings.
ANY.RUN reported in July that at least 20 .gov.br portals belonging to Brazilian municipalities and police forces had been used to distribute malware in a campaign it tracks as PhantomEnigma.
"These government systems are part of the delivery chain, not confirmed campaign targets," ANY.RUN said in a report published July 16.
Compromised .gov.br and .jus.br hosts should be handled separately from attacker-controlled infrastructure, ANY.RUN said, because blocking them broadly would disrupt access to government resources.
Brazil began licensing fixed-odds betting on January 1, 2025, under Law 14,790/2023, and authorized operators to run on .bet.br domains issued through Registro.br, Brazil's domain registry.
Check Point did not say whether the betting sites promoted through the compromised servers hold that authorization.
Once on a host, Check Point said the group deploys the following tools -
- DownPro, a custom downloader
- AlphaAgent, a modular backdoor
- oRAT, a remote access trojan (RAT)
- A 3snake-based credential stealer
- An SSH brute-forcer
- A plugin-driven reconnaissance agent
The public version of 3snake attaches ptrace to newly spawned sshd and sudo processes and extracts strings related to password-based authentication. Its documentation states that the tool targets rooted servers.
The Hacker News reviewed the 3snake source on GitHub on September 2, 2026, and confirmed both. The credentials used to administer a compromised server are therefore read by a component the operators control.
Check Point said it hasn't directly observed how the group obtains initial access. An exposed open directory on one of the actor's servers held an ELF binary written in Go that bundles reconnaissance and scanning plugins.
The material published so far includes no count of compromised servers and no module filenames, paths, or hashes that would let administrators check the modules loaded into their own Apache instances.
Parallel phishing networks localized in Vietnamese, Spanish, and English were also identified, along with infrastructure that generates new domains daily. Because the pages already mimic app-download destinations, Check Point said the operators sit "one step from pushing malware straight to victims."
The published summary names no affected organization and does not say whether the compromised servers have been cleaned.
Check Point tied the cluster to Earth Berberoka, an actor Trend Micro documented in 2022 as targeting gambling websites across Asia using malware families historically attributed to Chinese-speaking individuals.
Xnote, a Linux backdoor tied to the group, was reported in March during attacks on critical infrastructure in Asia.
oRAT, one of the Linux tools in that arsenal, was documented by Trend Micro in April 2022 as Earth Berberoka malware, in Windows and macOS samples both flagged as version 0.5.1. The Hacker News confirmed that provenance against Trend Micro's research on September 2, 2026.
ESET documented at least 65 Windows servers , mainly in Brazil, Thailand, and Vietnam, compromised in June 2025 by GhostRedirector, an actor it assessed with medium confidence as China-aligned, which installed a native Internet Information Services (IIS) module called Gamshen.
"GhostRedirector has developed a malicious native IIS module, Gamshen, that can perform SEO fraud; we believe its purpose is to artificially promote various gambling websites," ESET said.
Gamshen altered the server's response only when the request came from Googlebot, leaving ordinary visitors with the page they asked for.
Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 documented the same reverse-proxy technique on IIS servers in September 2025.
Hunt.io said in July 2025 that it had found more than 630,000 URLs generated on hijacked gov.br subdomains, serving keyword-stuffed government-style pages to Googlebot while redirecting real users to betting sites.
The company redacted certain indicators in coordination with Brazil's government incident response team, CTIR, while that investigation continued.
"The goal was not to break into systems. It was to control visibility," Hunt.io said.

articles.title: Acer Relaunches Packard Bell With a New Collection of Products
articles.text:
Wednesday, September 2nd 2026
	
									
	
	
	
Acer Relaunches Packard Bell With a New Collection of Products
At IFA 2026, Packard Bell, under the Acer Group, marks its 100th anniversary with a full relaunch: a new visual identity, a "Tech it easy" philosophy, and a new collection of products, led by the 14.5-inch DotBook laptop, arriving in European retail starting from Q4 2026.
Founded in 1926 in Los Angeles, Packard Bell first made consumer radios accessible to a wider audience, then helped democratize color television and, decades later, personal computers. Across every era, the brand built its reputation on the same principle: bringing useful technology to the many, not the few.A century later, that mission remains as relevant as ever. As electronics grow in complexity, Packard Bell comes back with a simpler question: what do people actually need? The answer fits in three words, "Tech it easy": Technology designed for everyday life, at an affordable price.
Valerie Piau, EMEA vice president, Acer Europe SA"Celebrating our 100th anniversary is the right moment to go back to our roots. People need technology that helps them study, work, and stay in touch, all at a fair price. That is what 'Tech it easy' means—our signature focus on keeping things simple,"
An Identity Designed for a New Generation 
The refreshed identity has been built around a single shape: the dot. The new emblem, a constellation of dots, hides the letters "P" and "B" in plain sight, an abstract nod to a century of history redrawn for the present. The dots are thought of as cells rather than pixels, a way of signaling technology that is human and built for real life.
The brand speaks the way it is designed. A warm, plain-spoken tone of voice replaces tech jargon; lifestyle imagery shows people using the products in their daily life. The company will first build its brand presence on digital channels, where the new generation of consumers shop. articles.title: X shifts US creator payouts from Stripe to X Money | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Elon Musk’s social network X on Wednesday said that starting today, all of its U.S. creator payouts will be handled through X Money, the app’s payments service.
This includes payouts from both X’s Original Content Rewards Program and creators’ subscriptions, the company said in an update shared on X.
The benefit of this new payment system is that the payments are instant. There’s no waiting until the end of a billing cycle or a minimum threshold that has to be reached before the creator can access their money. Previously, payments were processed every two weeks, with a minimum payout of $30, X’s documentation states.
However, the announcement’s wording seems to indicate that there aren’t any other options for receiving payments on the platform, meaning X is forcing creators to use X Money even if they would have preferred the prior payout method, which was powered by Stripe.
X has been asked for clarification on the matter.
The shift follows other changes to X’s creator programs. On September 7, X will retire its Creator Revenue Sharing Program, which stopped accepting new members last month. Creators are being shifted instead to the Original Content Rewards Program, which, as the name implies, puts a heavier emphasis on original content.
The company’s new payments service, X Money, began supporting creator payouts earlier this month. The payments offering, a part of Musk’s broader plan to make X an “everything app,” includes a bank card with 3% cashback, instant payments, free ATM withdrawals, and other digital banking services. However, X Money is not a bank itself; the accounts themselves are held at the FDIC-insured Cross River Bank.
X’s post said creator payouts will also count towards X Money users’ direct deposit requirements to receive the service’s better APY rate. Currently, the service’s website says X Premium users will get a boosted 6% rate, compared to the standard 4% rate.
In addition, X will issue a 1099-NEC for individuals receiving creator payouts. For LLCs, X will collect the organization’s W-9 information to ensure the 1099s are accurate, the company noted.

articles.title: Zerodha's Nithin Kamath says India's primary market is 'red hot'
articles.text:
Zerodha's Nithin Kamath says India's primary market is 'red hot'
Zerodha founder Nithin Kamath says India’s IPO market is booming despite a subdued broader market, but warns that strong listing gains, and even IPO allotments, aren’t guaranteed.
Zerodha founder Nithin Kamath says India’s primary market remains “red hot” even as the broader equity market struggles for momentum, with IPOs, Offer for Sale (OFS), and Follow-on Public Offers (FPOs) drawing strong investor interest.
In a LinkedIn post, Kamath said the amount raised through the primary market this year is already on track to match or exceed the levels seen in the previous two years. A strong pipeline of companies preparing to go public could further add to the momentum.
“While the broader markets have gone nowhere, the primary market (IPOs, OFS, and FPOs) is red hot. By capital raised, this year is already on track to match, if not surpass, the last two years. And there’s a big pipeline of IPOs coming up (link in comments)," said Kamath.
The IPO rush is also showing up on Zerodha’s platform. Kamath said the brokerage has seen a sharp increase in IPO applications, including users opening accounts specifically to participate in public offerings.
"Even at Zerodha, there’s been a big spike in IPO applications, including people opening accounts just to apply,” he added.
But strong demand does not necessarily translate into strong returns for investors. Kamath pointed to IPO listing data to highlight the difficulty of making money consistently from new listings.
Although 74–80% of IPOs opened above their issue price, “but a good chunk of them didn’t exactly deliver spectacular gains.”
In the latest period, 35% of IPOs opened just 0–10% above their issue price, while around 26% opened below the issue price, he added.
Kamath also pointed to another challenge for retail investors: getting an allotment in the first place.
“By the way, the one thing this chart doesn’t show is that the more popular the IPO, the lower your odds of actually getting an allotment.”
The primary market is expected to remain busy in the coming months, with companies such as Jio Platforms, PhonePe, Razorpay, and NSE among those expected to tap public markets.
Earlier this year, Shiprocket and Tata Capital also made their market debuts, adding to the IPO activity that has kept India’s primary market considerably more active than the broader equity market.

articles.title: Startup news and updates: Daily roundup (September 2, 2026)
articles.text:
Startup news and updates: Daily roundup (September 2, 2026)
YourStory presents the daily news roundup from the Indian startup ecosystem and beyond. Here's the roundup for Wednesday, September 2, 2026.
Another glass ceiling has been broken at the Indian Air Force as EVs continue to create waves, YourStory presents the daily news roundup from the Indian startup ecosystem and beyond. Here's the roundup for Wednesday, September 2, 2026.
Featured news
Shakti Sharma makes history as first woman appointed Air Vice Marshal
In a historic milestone for the Indian Air Force, Air Vice Marshal Shakti Sharma has become the first woman officer (non-medical) in the country's armed forces to attain the rank of air vice marshal or equivalent, officials said. She assumed the appointment of assistant chief of the air staff (education) at the Air Headquarters on September 1, they said. The air officer previously held the rank of air commodore, an IAF official said.
Funding news
Minimac Systems raises Rs 30 Cr led by Rainmatter
Minimac Systems has raised Rs 30 crore in a round led by Rainmatter by Zerodha, with participation from select venture capital firms, the company said. The Pune-based industrial deep-tech firm will use the capital for R&D in miniaturised treatment infrastructure and fluid analytics, to scale its Recycling on Wheels hubs, and to build out its Lubricants as a Service model.
Founded by Anshuman Agrawal, Minimac focuses on lubricant lifecycle management and circularity. According to the company, it has deployed more than 2,500 systems with combined capacity exceeding 300,000 litres per minute and kept over 14 million litres in productive use. It also referenced EPR for used oil as a regulatory tailwind.
72 Street raises Rs 4 Cr from angels, UHNIs
72 Street has raised Rs 4 crore from angel investors and UHNIs to support the 72 Street app and Venty, its AI-powered stock market researcher. The company said it plans to expand into Futures & Options, model portfolios, mutual funds and commodities. Of the Rs 3 crore invested in the business to date, 45% has gone towards technology and product development for the app and Venty.
Founded in late 2025 by Rohit Agarwal and Fal Ghancha, 72 Street is a SEBI-registered research analyst platform. According to the company, Venty scans more than 3,800 NSE- and BSE-listed stocks across fundamental, technical and sentiment indicators, with every generated insight reviewed by its SEBI-registered research analysts before publication.
Creedom raises Rs 4.1 crore in seed funding
Creedom, an AI growth coach for content creators, has raised Rs 4.1 crore in a seed funding round backed by a group of investors who include corporate executives and startup founders. The company said the capital will be used to strengthen its product for Indian creators, expand into the US and develop its AI capabilities. Creedom, which began as a learning platform, has reached more than 1.5 lakh creators in India. Its platform analyses Instagram and YouTube performance and provides personalised content insights through its AI companion..
Other news
Juspay launches Breeze Universal for AI shopping discovery
Juspay announced Breeze Universal, a global pilot that enables brand discovery across AI platforms including ChatGPT and Claude as well as merchants’ own surfaces, the company said. The product lets shoppers discover, compare and purchase within a single AI conversation across participating brands, and connects to stores on Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento and custom platforms. Users can invoke @breeze within ChatGPT for recommendations.
Built on Google’s Universal Commerce Protocol, Breeze Universal is aimed at banks, fintechs, marketplaces and brands that want to deploy agentic shopping without complex infrastructure. According to Juspay, it will be available as drop-in components, a headless kit or APIs, and can also publish @brand apps inside ChatGPT.
MediBuddy appoints Shalabh Shrivastava as Head of Operations
MediBuddy announced the appointment of Shalabh Shrivastava as Head of Operations on September 2, 2026. He will focus on strengthening systems, technology-led automation and execution as the company scales its healthcare network. The company said it reported its first EBITDA-positive quarter in Q4 FY26, with an annual revenue run rate above Rs 1,500 crore, and more than 90 percent year-on-year growth in online consultations.
Shrivastava brings over two decades of experience across Swiggy, Flipkart, Reliance Retail, Cognizant and Ernst and Young. At Swiggy, he led product, design and operations for the driver organisation. At Flipkart, he served as VP and National Head of Large and Furniture Supply Chain. He holds a BTech from IIT BHU and an MBA from XLRI Jamshedpur.
PayGlocal enters US with FinCEN MSB registration approval
PayGlocal said it has registered as a Money Services Business with the US Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, marking its first international market entry. The registration allows the cross-border payments firm to operate in the US as it builds compliance, banking and payments infrastructure. The company said it has processed transactions worth over $4.5 billion and serves more than 10,000 merchants across 180+ countries.
Licensed by the Reserve Bank of India as a Payment Aggregator for online and cross-border flows, PayGlocal enables acceptance in 130+ currencies and 40+ global and local payment methods.
Luma Fertility plans 30 centres, launches Luma Hope Grant
Luma Fertility said it has marked its first year with 120 ongoing pregnancies and 22 babies. It announced the Luma Hope Grant to fully fund 30 complete IVF treatment cycles, beginning with a first cohort of 10 cycles for eligible individuals and couples. The company plans to expand to 30 centres nationwide, starting with three additional centres in Mumbai.
Backed by Peak XV’s Surge, with participation from Ameera Shah and Vijay Taparia, Luma said its flagship Mumbai centre has reached break-even and recorded a 77% self-cycle success rate. The company highlighted RFID-based gamete tracking and AI-supported clinical workflows, and cited Twelve for Herself, an outcome-oriented egg-freezing programme.
Zoho launches Catalyst 3.0 for AI-assisted cloud development
Zoho has launched Catalyst 3.0, an agent-ready full-stack cloud development platform with AI IDE integrations, Agent Skills, MCP support and AI-assisted workflows. The company said the platform is designed to help developers move applications from AI coding assistants to production infrastructure without leaving the coding environment. It has also introduced a free student programme for educational and non-commercial use.
Catalyst 3.0 includes a non-interactive CLI and MCP support, while orchestration built into the Skill routes requests through either path. Zoho has also made its AI skills available as an open-source repository and is open-sourcing Catalyst's SDK, CLI and Slyte JavaScript framework. The platform is available for immediate use, according to the company.
Swiggy, Hero MotoCorp partner on mobility and rider safety
Swiggy and Hero MotoCorp have announced a partnership to provide Swiggy Food Marketplace and Instamart delivery partners with access to affordable personal mobility and road safety training. Under the partnership, Swiggy riders can select their preferred Hero model through the Swiggy app and avail exclusive pricing at Hero dealerships. Riders will also have access to customised financing solutions, including options offering up to 90% Loan-to-Value and competitive interest rates.
Razorpay launches AI account manager RAY on WhatsApp
Razorpay has launched RAY, an AI Account Manager on WhatsApp, in partnership with IndusInd Bank, with Bajaj Finance among the first businesses to go live on the platform. Designed for businesses of all sizes, RAY enables founders to manage payments and access support through conversational interactions rather than traditional dashboards. Razorpay said businesses have already had more than 20,000 conversations with RAY. Users can send a text or voice note asking for payment summaries, analyse transactions or seek sales projections, with the AI responding in natural language.
Decathlon partners with FirstCry to expand kids’ sports range
Decathlon Sports India has partnered with FirstCry to make sports gear more accessible to young families across the country. The collaboration supports Decathlon’s vision of engaging new customer segments and encouraging active wellbeing through sport. Under the partnership, FirstCry customers can access a curated range of Decathlon children’s products spanning apparel, footwear, accessories and sports essentials. The partnership gives Decathlon access to FirstCry’s community of more than 25 million registered users across metros and Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets.
Account Aggregator ecosystem crosses 500 million fulfilled consents
India’s Account Aggregator ecosystem has crossed 500 million fulfilled consents, marking five years of consent-based, customer-controlled financial data sharing. The ecosystem now has more than 1,100 regulated entities live on the platform, with over 2.8 billion financial accounts enabled for sharing and more than 310 million accounts linked by customers. It has also facilitated over 600 crore data fetches to date. Lending remains the largest use case. In FY26, Account Aggregator-enabled lending reached Rs 3.82 lakh crore across 3.68 crore loans, equivalent to more than 1% of India’s GDP. Such lending accounted for 8.4% of retail and MSME lending by value and 11.8% by volume during the year. Adoption is also expanding into insurance, investments, wealth management, personal finance and risk assessment.
WLDD gets investment from Adfactors PR, Vikas Khemani
WLDD, a content distribution and creator-led marketing company founded in 2018, has announced that Adfactors PR and Vikas Khemani, Founder and CIO of Carnelian Asset Management & Advisors, have acquired a stake in the company. WLDD said the investment will support the expansion of its technology, creator ecosystem, content platforms and brand solutions as businesses compete increasingly for attention, trust and recall. Headquartered in Bengaluru, the company also has offices in Mumbai and Delhi. Its client portfolio includes brands such as Amazon, Coca-Cola, OpenAI, Spotify, Netflix, Tata Motors, Philips, Rapido, Tinder and Audible.
SaveIN revenue jumps 80% to Rs 27.9 crore in FY26
Fintech platform SaveIN reported an 80% year-on-year increase in total revenue to Rs 27.9 crore in FY2025-26, compared with Rs 15.7 crore in the previous financial year. Its core operating revenue grew 75% to Rs 24.1 crore and has increased more than five-fold over the past two financial years. SaveIN disbursed loans worth more than Rs 400 crore during FY26 and has since scaled its annualised loan disbursal run-rate to over Rs 700 crore. The company now has more than 8,000 retail touch points across 130-plus cities and 15,000 pin codes. It has set a target of reaching a Rs 2,000 crore annualised disbursal run-rate over the next 12 months.
Delhivery’s TransportOne launches agentic AI workforce for logistics
TransportOne by Delhivery has launched an agentic AI workforce for logistics, bringing together six specialised AI agents to support transportation workflows and operations. The platform is designed to handle day-to-day activities across the logistics lifecycle while allowing human teams to retain oversight and intervene where judgement is required. According to Delhivery, the AI agents can identify and recover freight overcharges through invoice audits, negotiate simultaneously with carriers to secure competitive spot rates and identify potential service-level deviations.
Hostinger expands Kodee into agentic AI platform
Hostinger has expanded its AI assistant Kodee into Hostinger Agent, an agentic platform combining customer support with specialised capabilities for creating, planning, analysing and automating work. Kodee had previously resolved 91% of around 1.5 million support conversations each month independently. Hostinger Agent can now draw on a customer’s website or store, domain, business email, newsletters, previous conversations and ongoing work to take action. Its specialised agents cover marketing, SEO, content and visuals, analysis and recurring tasks. When the system is uncertain, it can seek assistance from a human specialist while continuing to learn. Hostinger Agent is also integrated into AI Builder, the company’s environment for creating websites, stores, apps and other online projects. Hostinger said the platform aims to unify the digital business experience for its more than five million clients.
SiMa.ai, ARK Electronics partner on autonomous drones
Physical AI company SiMa.ai has partnered with ARK Electronics to accelerate the development and deployment of next-generation autonomous drones. The companies are launching ARK-SiMa.ai Modalix MLSoC Bundles, described as production-ready and affordable solutions designed to simplify the development of intelligent drones for commercial and defence applications. By combining SiMa.ai’s technology with ARK Electronics’ expertise in drones and robotics, the companies aim to provide an integrated Physical AI foundation for commercial, industrial, agriculture and defence deployments.
GoCredit launches free checker for loan app safety
Fintech platform GoCredit has launched a free loan app checker that enables borrowers to verify whether a lending application is genuine, fake or operated by an RBI-registered lender. Users can enter the name of a loan app, after which the tool checks it against the Reserve Bank of India’s public directory of Digital Lending Apps deployed by regulated entities. The checker also cross-references more than 9,200 RBI-registered entities. If a match is found, users can see the regulated entity behind the app, its grievance redressal officer and the escalation route to the RBI Ombudsman. Where there is no match, GoCredit said the tool does not label the app as fraudulent but instead provides a verification checklist and official reporting channels.
Headsup B2B, StrideOne offer invoice-backed working capital
Headsup B2B Private Limited has partnered with StrideOne, an RBI-registered NBFC and embedded-finance platform, to offer working capital financing to eligible buyers on its marketplace. Under the partnership, businesses can access short-term, invoice-backed credit for purchases made through the platform. The facility is aimed at addressing working capital requirements where businesses purchase materials for projects or operations before receiving payments from their customers. Eligible buyers can obtain financing against approved invoices linked to platform transactions. StrideOne will provide financing infrastructure and lender access, while Headsup B2B will make the facility available to eligible buyers.
QubeHealth-Pay expands into MENA with Dubai entity
QubeHealth-Pay has expanded into the Middle East and North Africa with the launch of Qube FinTech & AI MENA Limited, a newly licensed entity operating from the Dubai International Financial Centre. Qube MENA will serve as the company’s regional headquarters for the GCC and North Africa and represents its first market outside India. Unlike QubePay’s consumer payments and cashback business in India, the new entity will focus on enterprise customers including insurers, employers, hospital networks and pharmaceutical companies. Its technology will address healthcare financial processes such as digital expense processing, claims facilitation, documentation, bill adjudication support, reconciliation and consent-driven healthcare data insights.
FYERS launches AI and automation tools for traders
Brokerage and investment platform FYERS has launched a suite of advanced trading tools powered by AI and automation, targeting both systematic and discretionary traders. For systematic traders, FYERS is bringing FYERS Automate and FIA together into a connected system. Traders can describe strategies in plain English, with FIA converting them into strategies that can be backtested and deployed without coding. Automate can then execute the strategy end-to-end without manual intervention. For discretionary traders, FYERS has introduced Order Flow on Smart Charts, offering deeper insights into buying and selling activity behind price movements. The feature includes Footprint Charts, Delta, Cumulative Delta, Imbalances and Volume Profile.
DXC Technology appoints Arun Melkote as Global Head of Delivery
DXC Technology has appointed Arun Melkote as Global Head of Delivery for Consulting & Engineering Services, alongside leadership changes aimed at strengthening its presence in a key region. Reporting to Ramnath Venkataraman, President of CES, Melkote will lead the company’s global delivery organisation for consulting and engineering services, focusing on delivery excellence, operational discipline and customer outcomes. His responsibilities cover the CES delivery portfolio, including expansion of DXC’s Global Capability Center offerings and leadership of the Custom Applications service line.
Addverb reports water-positive operations and lower emissions
Robotics and warehouse automation company Addverb has reported a Water Positivity Index of 1.51 for FY2025–26, resulting in its facility being categorised as Water Positive. The company said it reduced overall water consumption by 30% through system optimisation despite an increase in its workforce. Reviews of legal compliance related to water abstraction, use, recycling and discharge found no major non-compliance during the verification period. Addverb also reported a 72.78% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions intensity and harvested 18,573 kilolitres of rainwater at its Bot Valley and Bot Verse facilities. Its solar installations generated an average of 1,606 kWh of clean energy daily, while renewable sources met 11.57% of total energy demand. The company said these efforts helped mitigate 416.33 tCO₂e emissions during FY26, alongside reductions in Scope 1 and Scope 3 emissions.
Flexible workspace searches account for 73% of office searches
Flexible workspaces now account for 73% of office searches by Indians, while traditional leasing represents fewer than 27% of total searches, according to a report by myHQ. The findings indicate growing demand for flexible and on-demand workspace formats, with the trend extending to Tier 2 markets and overseas companies considering India. The report said generic searches for “coworking space” are plateauing, while searches linked to specific use cases are rising sharply. Meeting room searches increased 187% over three years, from 34,000 to 98,000 monthly searches, while virtual office searches rose 99% and day-pass searches increased 20%. Together, use-case-specific categories now account for nearly 90% of coworking search demand. Managed office searches have grown 778% since 2022, highlighting changing preferences in how businesses seek workspace solutions.
90+ My Tuition App opens Delhi office amid expansion
K-12 education platform 90+ My Tuition App has opened a new office in New Delhi as it expands beyond its established markets in Kerala and the GCC. The new Delhi base is aimed at supporting the company’s national expansion, particularly across the CBSE education ecosystem. The office will support academic, business development and operational activities in North India. The move follows a strategic investment in the company from Equity Intelligence, led by investor Porinju Veliyath. The investment will support national expansion, technology and product development and the company’s next-generation AI Teacher Programme.
Broadcom introduces VMware Private AI Cloud
Broadcom has introduced VMware Private AI Cloud, a private-cloud approach designed to help enterprises build, run and govern AI inference workloads, agentic applications and traditional enterprise workloads together. The platform follows a “bring the model to the data” approach, aiming to provide greater security, scalability and flexibility for enterprise AI deployments. Broadcom said VMware Private AI Cloud offers organisations a production-ready environment with diverse hardware, model and accelerator choices. It is designed to address three major AI cost drivers: hardware capital expenditure, operational complexity and token economics.
Shoonya launches free FnO Edge options trading toolkit
Digital trading platform Shoonya, operated by Finvasia, has launched FnO Edge, an options trading toolkit that combines market analysis, strategy building, risk assessment and execution on a single platform. The tool is being integrated with Shoonya Pro and is available free of charge to all Shoonya users. Powered by ClickTrade, FnO Edge is designed for manual trading and does not involve algorithmic or automated trading. The toolkit follows a five-stage workflow: Analyse, Build, Evaluate, Simulate and Execute. Traders can begin by examining the option chain and constructing a strategy before evaluating potential outcomes, testing different scenarios and placing trades.
BankSathi appoints Nitish Kumar Bugalia as co-founder, COO
Technology-led credit inclusion platform BankSathi has appointed Nitish Kumar Bugalia as Co-Founder and Chief Operating Officer. With more than 12 years of experience spanning fintech, technology and consumer internet businesses, Bugalia will lead product, operations and technology as BankSathi enters its next phase of growth. At BankSathi, Bugalia will work with Founder and CEO Jitendra Dhaka and Co-Founder and CTO Sandeep Kaler to strengthen technology and product capabilities, operating systems and the overall customer experience.
Genefied appoints Neha Lakhwara to lead investment relations
Enterprise SaaS company Genefied has appointed Neha Lakhwara as Head of Investment Relations & Strategy. The company specialises in supply chain traceability, anti-counterfeiting and loyalty technology. Lakhwara brings more than 10 years of experience across legal and investment roles. Genefied said the appointment comes as it expands its enterprise customer base and international footprint.

articles.title: Mercedes Spinout Athos Closes Its Doors - EE Times
articles.text:
Automotive functional safety chiplet startup Athos Silicon has closed its doors.
Former Athos CEO Charnjiv Bangar told EE Times that Athos has ceased operations after its board made the decision to wind down and dissolve the company.
“Despite extensive efforts, we were unable to secure the financing required to continue the productization and commercialization of our technology,” Bangar said. “This was not a decision we made lightly. The technology was consistently well received by the technical community and prospective partners with whom we engaged. Ultimately, the challenge was financial and cap-table related rather than technical, and the board made its decision on the company’s financing position.”
Athos had spun out of Mercedes-Benz after five years of incubation, with Mercedes making a strategic investment that included substantial IP. The team had been addressing functional safety for autonomous driving and other autonomy applications with a new architecture that combined multiple chiplets to offer a level of redundancy in case of hardware failures. Key to the architecture is a patented voting mechanism that enables chiplets to monitor their neighbors for failures. The architecture also includes techniques for moving workloads between chiplets to provide uninterrupted service in the event of a failure.
Athos originally developed its architecture around purchasing and integrating third-party chiplets, including DreamBig’s chiplet hub, but redrew its roadmap following the acquisition of DreamBig by Arm. The new plan had been to tape out Athos’s own SoC chiplet using third-party IP, using multiples of a single tape-out on an organic substrate to keep costs down.
The startup had been targeting autonomous driving in the long term and small autonomous systems such as drones in the near term with a single-chiplet version of the design.
Under the licensing agreement with Mercedes-Benz, the original IP licensed from Mercedes has reverted back to them. IP developed after the spinout remains with its inventors, Bangar said.

articles.title: Microsoft s’apprête à renforcer automatiquement la sécurité de millions de PC Windows 11, voici ce qui va changer
articles.text:
À partir du mois prochain, Windows 11 activera automatiquement l’intégrité de la mémoire sur davantage de PC compatibles. Une protection importante du noyau, qui peut toutefois poser problème avec des pilotes anciens.
L’intégrité de la mémoire n’est pas nouvelle dans Windows et pourtant, de nombreux PC compatibles fonctionnent encore sans. Microsoft veut donc rattraper ce retard et commencera, dès le mois d’octobre, à l’activer automatiquement via les mises à jour qualité de Windows 11. Sur les machines éligibles, si ce n’est pas déjà fait, le système pourra également enclencher la sécurité basée sur la virtualisation nécessaire au fonctionnement de cette protection du noyau.
La solution tout-en-un pour protéger votre entreprise
Votre petite entreprise a de grandes ambitions. Protégez-là contre les pirates. Et développez sereinement votre activité !
Mieux protéger le noyau contre les pilotes vulnérables
Également connue sous le nom de HVCI, l’intégrité de la mémoire s’appuie sur la virtualisation matérielle pour isoler une partie des contrôles de sécurité de Windows. Avant qu’un pilote ou du code puisse s’exécuter au niveau du noyau, le système vérifie qu’il respecte ses règles d’intégrité. Ce contrôle supplémentaire permet notamment de bloquer les attaques qui exploitent des pilotes vulnérables ou compromis, généralement détournés pour obtenir des privilèges très élevés sur la machine.
La fonction existe depuis Windows 10 et Microsoft l’active déjà par défaut sur la plupart des PC récents. Il en va de même pour les installations propres de Windows 11 sur les machines un peu plus anciennes, sous réserve de remplir les critères requis : processeur suffisamment récent, au moins 8 Go de RAM sur les systèmes x64, SSD de 64 Go minimum, virtualisation activée et pilotes compatibles.
L’activation automatique annoncée pour octobre concerne donc essentiellement les ordinateurs mis à niveau au fil des années et passés entre les mailles du filet, alors même qu’ils remplissaient déjà les conditions matérielles et logicielles nécessaires.
Une activation encadrée pour éviter les mauvaises surprises
Dans la majorité des cas, le changement devrait passer inaperçu. Quelques problèmes pourraient toutefois surgir si un périphérique ou un logiciel repose encore sur un pilote ancien, incompatible avec les restrictions imposées par HVCI. Windows pourrait alors refuser de le charger, ce qui empêcherait le matériel concerné de fonctionner correctement et pourrait, dans les cas les plus sérieux, perturber le démarrage du PC.
Microsoft ne compte donc pas modifier la configuration de toutes les machines compatibles sans vérification préalable. Avant d’activer la fonction, Windows tiendra compte de leur configuration matérielle, de la compatibilité des pilotes installés et de l’impact attendu sur les performances. En cas de pépin malgré tout, le système pourra aussi faire marche arrière automatiquement et désactiver HVCI pour permettre au PC de redémarrer normalement.
Enfin, Microsoft respectera les choix déjà effectués par les utilisateurs et les administrateurs. Si l’intégrité de la mémoire a été volontairement désactivée sur un PC, le déploiement d’octobre ne reviendra pas sur ce réglage.

articles.title: WhatsApp va bientôt cesser de fonctionner sur ces anciens smartphones Android et iOS
articles.text:
WhatsApp va bientôt cesser de fonctionner sur ces anciens smartphones Android et iOS
Dès ce mois de septembre, d'anciens smartphones Android ne pourront plus utiliser WhatsApp. Même chose pour de vieux iPhone en novembre.
Régulièrement, les développeurs d'applications et de services décident de ne plus supporter des terminaux jugés obsolètes. Que cela soit pour des raisons d'économies, de performances trop limitées ou de sécurité insuffisante (ou les trois), Meta ne fait pas exception. En cette fin 2026, c'est son application de messagerie WhatsApp qui va cesser de fonctionner sur d'anciens smartphones Android et iOS.
Probablement peu d'appareils concernés
La bonne nouvelle, contrairement à des services de streaming qui parfois abandonnent des appareils pas si anciens, c'est que cette fin de support de WhatsApp ne devrait pas concerner beaucoup de personnes. Des appareils généralement vendus entre 2013 et 2015 sont visés, proposés par toutes les marques comme Apple, Google, Samsung, LG, Sony et autres Huawei.
Côté Android, dès le 8 septembre 2026 il faudra disposer d'un appareil fonctionnant au minimum sous Android 6. Pour iOS, alors que pour le moment la version 15.1 est supportée, ce sera au minimum la mouture 15.5 qui sera réclamée à partir du 30 novembre.
Pour les personnes en dessous, Meta indiquera directement la situation dans WhatsApp. Le cas échéant, le moment sera probablement venu de changer de smartphone, d'autant que l'ancien appareil concerné n'aura pas reçu de rustines de sécurité depuis des années.
WhatsApp est une messagerie instantanée gratuite et sécurisée qui vous permet de garder le contact avec tous vos amis ou votre famille, vous pouvez la télécharger et l'installer sur toutes les plateformes.

- Systèmes d'exploitation : Windows 10 / 11, macOS, Service en ligne, Android, iOS iPhone
- Catégorie : Communication

Avant de changer de téléphone, n'hésitez pas à faire une sauvegarde de vos conversations WhatsApp au cas où.

articles.title: Ferran Adrià: "Si voy a un restaurante con amigos, quiero buen servicio. Si me preguntas al día siguiente qué he comido, muchas veces ni me acuerdo"
articles.text:
Empecemos con un pequeño juego. Piensa en la última vez que estuviste en un restaurante y luego intenta recordar dos cosas. La primera es por qué fuiste. A los bares se va a comer y beber, ya lo sé, pero medita bien si el objetivo principal era ese (disfrutar de lo que había en el plato) o más bien acudiste para pasar un rato con tus amigos y familia. Ahora intenta recordar exactamente qué comiste. Tal vez te parezcan cuestiones absurdas, pero captan la esencia de la hostelería.
No lo decimos nosotros, lo dice Ferran Adrià.
¿Qué ha pasado? En el panorama gastronómico español hay (afortunadamente) muchos nombres que merecen escribirse con mayúsculas, pero pocos han alcanzado las cotas de prestigio y popularidad de Ferran Adrià, el alma de elBulli. De ahí que sus reflexiones merezcan una atención especial.
Hace poco el chef se pasó por el podcast 'Talent Hostelería' para hablar de su trayectoria, gastronomía y sobre todo cómo debe gestionarse un restaurante. La charla duró cerca de una hora y dejó algunas perlas, como las que han recogido nuestros compañeros de Directo al Paladar sobre la esencia de la hostelería y qué buscan habitualmente los clientes cuando acuden a un restaurante.
¿Para qué vas al bar? Lo comentábamos antes. En principio parece una pregunta absurda, casi ingenua. Uno acude a un bar, bocatería, asador, pizzería, marisquería… para comer y beber, ¿no? La realidad, como recuerda Adria, es más compleja. Una vez en el local quizás nos entregamos a los placeres de la pitanza, pero eso no significa que lo que nos ha movido hasta allí sea la búsqueda de una experiencia culinaria. De hecho, recuerda el chef, eso ocurre pocas veces.
Par demostrarlo Adrià cita un informe que asegura que "el 95% de la gente que sale a restaurantes lo hace para socializar". "La comida es lo segundo", apostilla. Lo raro es "acudir a un sitio gastronómico" y estar "concentrado" en los paltos.
El propio chef reconoce que la mayor parte de las veces que él mismo pisa un comedor lo hace con el primer enfoque. Según sus cálculos, come o cena fuera entre 250 y 300 veces a lo largo del año, pero si hablamos de disfrutar de la experiencia gastronómica en sí el número de visitas se reduce a 20 o 25.
¿Es eso cierto? El porcentaje que aporta Adrià (90-95%) es bastante elevado, pero hay múltiples informes que confirman que, efectivamente, la mayor parte de las veces que visitamos un restaurante no lo hacemos pensando en el menú, sino en la compañía. Comemos, cierto, y lo disfrutamos, cierto también; pero el objetivo no es el disfrute gastronómico, sino compartir mesa y charla.
Así lo refleja una encuesta elaborada por Restalia e IPSOS que muestra que casi el 60% de los españoles confiesa que el principal motivo por el que decide acudir a un restaurante es la socialización. Esa razón se sitúa por delante de otras, como la búsqueda de nuevos sabores o incluso las retiencias a cocinar en casa.
Es más, cuando Restalia e IPSOS preguntaron a los encuestados qué es lo que más valoran al comer fuera, el 65% aludió a la comida y el 62% la compañía. Hay otros estudios que muestran que la gran mayoría de jóvenes (el 79%) escogen los bares, cafeterías y restaurantes como espacios para alternar con sus amigos.
¿Qué es lo realmente importante? Durante la entrevista en 'Talent Hostelería', Adrià reflexionó también sobre los valores que más aprecia en la hostelería, más allá de lo que se sirve en el plato o la variedad de bebidas.
Y en ese aspecto rompió una lanza en favor del servicio, pieza clave en los negocios. "Si voy a un restaurante con mis amigos, quiero un buen servicio, lo primero. Y comer bien". Prueba del valor que le da a lo primero es que, admite, muchas veces "si me preguntas al día siguiente qué he comido ni me acuerdo".
¿Son todos los restaurantes iguale? La reflexión es interesante porque conecta con otra idea del cocinero: la hostelería es un universo amplio en el que conviven locales que no siempre persiguen los mismos objetivos. De hecho Adrià reconoce que hay negocios que ofrecen productos de calidad sin que eso implique necesariamente que apuesten por la alta cocina. A lo que sí anima el creador catalán es a "hacer un esfuerzo" y cuidar el servicio, sea cual sea el enfoque.
"Hay que apostar por la calidad, pero entendiendo que no hay que ser populista", aboga el chef, quien revindica una visión amplia de la gastronomía y su capacidad para adaptarse a cada contexto y las posibilidades de los consumidores. De hecho el impulsor de elBulli ha reconocido que, dada su capacidad para ajustar costes y adaptarse al contexto, "lo que hace McDonald´s es una obra de arte".

articles.title: Seulement trois coloris attendus pour les iPhone 18 Pro : une teinte emblématique d’Apple va-t-elle tirer sa révérence ?
articles.text:
Seulement trois coloris attendus pour les iPhone 18 Pro : une teinte emblématique d’Apple va-t-elle tirer sa révérence ?
Les rumeurs se poursuivent autour des iPhone 18 Pro, avec un chamboulement au menu des coloris de cette génération. Mauvaise nouvelle pour les adeptes des teintes claires et neutres : Apple ferait l’impasse dessus.
Alors que l’iPhone 18 Pro Max profiterait de quelques nouveautés exclusives sur la partie photo, il partagerait bel et bien les mêmes coloris que son petit frère. D’après une nouvelle rumeur, les déclinaisons se limiteraient finalement à trois teintes, abandonnant l’emblématique finition gris/blanc d’Apple utilisée sur les générations précédentes. En échange, le noir ferait son grand retour, tandis que des teintes plus affirmées viendraient dominer cette nouvelle gamme.
Pas de coloris gris ou blanc pour les iPhone 18 Pro, mais le retour du noir et de teintes inédites
D’après les informations du divulgâcheur chinois Fixed Focus Digital, l’entrée en phase de production de masse des iPhone 18 Pro balaye d’un revers de la main la possibilité d’un lancement avec quatre coloris, la marque s’arrêtant sur trois teintes distinctes.
Le Dark Cherry, un bordeaux d’un rouge profond, serait ainsi le grand remplaçant du Cosmic Orange, alors que le Sky Blue renouerait avec l’appétence d'Apple pour les nuances azurées. Le noir ferait ensuite son grand retour après avoir brillé par son absence sur l’iPhone 17 Pro, comblant l’attente de nombreux utilisateurs pour cette déclinaison.
Le traditionnel coloris argent, qui offrait jusqu'ici une alternative sobre et claire, passerait ainsi à la trappe. Le leaker précise d’ailleurs n’avoir décelé aucune trace de son existence sur les chaînes de production.
L’abandon de la teinte argentée suscite encore le doute
MacRumors rappelle tout de même que plusieurs fuites précédentes, notamment de maquettes des iPhone 18 Pro, de leurs tiroirs SIM ou encore de tests en interne, laissaient entrevoir une déclinaison argentée aux côtés des teintes noire, bordeaux et bleue. Le doute plane donc encore, dans l’attente d’une confirmation d’Apple lors de la keynote d’officialisation du 9 septembre.
Ces trois nouvelles teintes du châssis en titane s’accorderaient avec un remaniement bienvenu de la zone MagSafe à l’arrière. Là où les teintes se différenciaient nettement de celles de la génération précédente, les iPhone 18 Pro joueraient davantage la carte de la continuité pour offrir un rendu visuel plus discret et harmonieux.
Dynamic Island plus compacte et batterie renforcée
Pour rappel, les iPhone 18 Pro ne se différencieraient pas des iPhone 17 Pro uniquement par leurs coloris. En effet, la Dynamic Island verrait sa taille réduite pour offrir une plus grande surface d’affichage, tout en accueillant la nouvelle interface circulaire de Siri dopée à l’IA sous iOS 20. À cela s’ajouterait un format légèrement plus épais pour la variante Pro Max afin d'intégrer une batterie de plus grande capacité.

articles.text:
Para atletas: Garmin Forerunner 165 despenca 42% no Mercado Livre
Forerunner 165 tem GPS integrado e resiste a mergulhos de até 50 m; melhor oferta que já vimos traz um dos melhores smartwatches da Garmin com desconto de 42% no Pix
O Forerunner 165 está saindo por apenas R$ 1.587 no Pix no Mercado Livre. A melhor oferta vista pelo Achados traz o smartwatch da Garmin, com GPS integrado e boa relação custo-benefício para esportistas, com desconto de 42% sobre o preço original de R$ 2.749.
Um dos melhores smartwatches da Garmin, o Forerunner 165 é uma opção acessível com vários recursos, especialmente para corredores. Ele permite planejamento, preparação e execução dessa atividade, além do recurso Garmin Coach oferecer planos de treinamento para provas, sugestões de exercícios diários e tempo de recuperação.
O smartwatch inteligente ainda monitora outras modalidades com planos dedicados e traz funções relacionadas ao sono, saúde da mulher e hidratação para melhor qualidade de vida. Sua tela AMOLED de 1,2″ reproduz imagens com cores vibrantes e tem alta visibilidade sob luz forte do sol.
O corpo de 43 mm fabricado por polímero reforçado com fibra resiste até 50 m de profundidade (5 ATM), sendo assim um acessório apto para esportes aquáticos. O GPS multibanda mede o ritmo médio (pace) e distância percorrida, e seus sensores medem a frequência cardíaca do usuário em tempo real.
O Forerunner 165 conta também com recursos de resposta a emergências: quando pareado a um celular via Bluetooth, ele pode enviar mensagens a contatos específicos se o usuário não se recuperar de uma queda, ou em uma emergência médica mais séria.
O wearable conta com 4 GB de memória interna e é compatível com iPhone e smartphones Android. Ele pode controlar apps de mídia e receber notificações, e tem recursos de pagamentos via app Garmin Pay apesar da limitação de bancos disponíveis.
Por fim, o Garmin Forerunner 165 (apenas R$ 1.587 no Pix) possui uma bateria com autonomia de até 11 dias no modo de economia de energia, segundo a Garmin; resistindo por volta de 19 horas com o GPS ligado.

articles.title: Llevamos décadas buscando lunas fuera del Sistema Solar: estos chilenos están convencidos de que han encontrado una
articles.text:
En nuestro sistema solar se conocen más de 400 lunas que orbitan alrededor de planetas. Si además tenemos en cuenta las que giran en torno a planetas enanos o asteroides, conocemos casi 1.000 satélites. Sin embargo, hasta el momento, no hay una evidencia clara de la existencia de lunas más allá de nuestro vecindario. Si bien se conocen más de 6.000 exoplanetas, no se ha encontrado ninguna luna orbitándolos. Ahora bien, ¿significa eso que no existen lunas fuera de nuestro sistema planetario? No necesariamente. Lo más probable es que sí las haya, pero hasta ahora no las hayamos podido encontrar. Por eso es tan interesante el hallazgo que hizo recientemente un equipo de científicos de la Universidad Diego Portales de Chile. De momento, es la descripción más sólida de la que podría ser la primera luna fuera de nuestro sistema solar. Hace unos meses se encontró otra, pero las pruebas son mucho más contundentes en este caso.
La enana marrón de la discordia. El hallazgo se ha hecho en el sistema CD-35 2722, formado por una pequeña estrella tipo M y una enana marrón girando a su alrededor. Las enanas marrones son objetos difíciles de explicar, ya que están a medio camino entre una estrella y un planeta. Por eso, cuando estos científicos detectaron lo que parecía ser la prueba de un objeto girando a su alrededor, se sintieron emocionados y confusos. Podrían estar por fin ante el descubrimiento de una luna fuera del sistema solar, ¿pero sigue pudiendo considerarse una luna si gira alrededor de una enana marrón?
A medio camino. Una estrella cuenta con suficiente energía interna para poder fusionar átomos de hidrógeno en helio, generando aún más energía en el proceso. En cambio, un planeta no puede llevar a cabo este proceso, por lo que necesita recibir la energía de alguna estrella cercana o la que se generó en su interior durante su formación. Las enanas marrones están entre medias porque no son capaces de fusionar hidrógeno, pero sí un isótopo del mismo llamado deuterio. En el proceso se genera menos energía, de ahí que estén bastante frías, pero lo cierto es que eso las aleja de poder considerarse planetas.
Bamboleo. Los responsables de este hallazgo estaban estudiando la velocidad radial de la enana marrón cuando vieron una serie de fluctuaciones que solo pudieron explicar con la presencia de un objeto girando a su alrededor. Cuando esto ocurre, el objeto más grande, que en este caso sería la enana marrón, atrae hacia sí al otro objeto, pero la propia enana marrón también se bambolea, acercándose y alejándose hacia un punto desde el que se esté observando. Esto genera cambios en su espectro de emisión, que pueden medirse mediante la técnica de la velocidad radial. Además, mediante el análisis de estos cambios puede calcularse el tamaño del objeto que ha provocado el bamboleo. En este caso se vio que tendría el 90% de la masa de Júpiter y que se mueve en una órbita de 170 días alrededor de la enana marrón.
¿Luna sí o no? La Unión Astronómica Internacional no cuenta con una definición clara sobre lo que es una luna. Por lo tanto, aunque este objeto no gire en torno a un planeta, sino a una enana marrón, podría ser aceptable que se considere una luna. Aun así, por ahora, los responsables del hallazgo lo han calificado como un exosatélite.
Cabe destacar que muchas enanas marrones se encuentran solas en el espacio, mientras que esta gira en torno a una estrella, de modo que tiene un punto extra de parecido a los planetas. Eso le confiere aún más parecido a un satélite.
Una posible exoluna muy peculiar. Algo aún más interesante de todo esto es que la enana marrón tiene una órbita tan excéntrica que la presencia de ese tercer objeto en el sistema debería haber causado mucho caos. Aun así, ahí está. Si ha permanecido a pesar de las dificultades, vale la pena seguir investigando. Parece que sí es una exoluna y lo mejor de todo es que posiblemente sea la primera de muchas.
